diagnoses.bug: The parser validates range endpoints as numbers before rejecting a starred endpoint, so `*-01` reports LeadingZero instead of InvalidSyntax at the item start.
diagnoses.lesson: Validate a construct’s complete structure before parsing its component values, so malformed syntax takes precedence over value-level errors.

diagnoses.bug: The parser validates the step before validating numeric bases and range ordering, so an item with both an invalid base and an invalid step can report the step error first.
diagnoses.lesson: Validate syntax first, then process dependent values in the required order; defer later-component errors until earlier components have been checked.

diagnoses.bug: Dependency provenance tokens use `deps[j]` instead of the required `deps[j]`? The specification requires `deps[j]`?
diagnoses.lesson: Translate every specified output token literally, then verify generated strings against the required format.

diagnoses.bug: CFWS inside a comment is discarded without extending the current run, so adjacent whitespace and comments can be split and a later boundary check can miss or misplace the required CfwsBoundary error.
diagnoses.lesson: Track each maximal removable run across all adjacent whitespace and nested constructs, preserving its first and last original byte positions until boundary validation.

diagnoses.bug: When traversal reaches a file before the final component, lookup reports NotDir for the preceding prefix instead of the file’s own canonical path.
diagnoses.lesson: When reporting traversal failures, track and report the exact component that caused the failure, rather than the last successfully traversed prefix.

diagnoses.bug: When write follows a dangling final link, it matches the Missing target path against the original link path, then creates a file at the link path instead of the expanded target.
diagnoses.lesson: Preserve both the requested path and the resolved physical path during lookup; apply mutations to the resolved target while retaining aliases.

diagnoses.bug: resolve_core uses path.find("..") for every root escape, so it reports the first parent-like substring instead of the offending component’s original byte offset.
diagnoses.lesson: Track each parsed component’s source offset through traversal, and report errors from the exact component that triggered them.

diagnoses.bug: A failed cancel of a queued-state lookup updates no clock, but next_ready assigns last_time before returning its result, violating the requirement that errors leave all state unchanged only if a later error path is introduced; currently the concrete bug is successful empty next_ready correctly advances time, so none of the listed requirements appears violated.
diagnoses.lesson: Audit every state mutation against the operation’s success and error paths, including early returns.

diagnoses.bug: The first poll includes earlier matching boundaries for jobs added after a previous poll, despite those jobs only participating in later poll intervals.
diagnoses.lesson: Track when each item enters a stateful system, and exclude it from work that predates its insertion.

diagnoses.bug: After a successful run stops between events, the next call starts searching at horizon + 1, so it can miss an event exactly at the previous horizon that was not processed.
diagnoses.lesson: When splitting incremental processing across calls, preserve pending work at the boundary; advance past a timestamp only after all events due there have been handled.

diagnoses.bug: When a minus sign is not followed by a numerator digit, parsing reports the position after the sign instead of the first invalid byte at offset 0.
diagnoses.lesson: Validate malformed prefixes against the grammar’s first violating byte, including signs and other optional markers.

diagnoses.bug: Parsing accepts a slash before any numerator digit and reports a missing digit at the end instead of InvalidByte at the slash offset.
diagnoses.lesson: Validate grammar left to right with explicit parser states, reporting the first byte that cannot continue the current state.

diagnoses.bug: When a minus sign is not followed by a digit, parsing reports InvalidByte at the position after the sign instead of identifying the sign at byte 0 as the first grammar violation.
diagnoses.lesson: Validate tokens against the complete grammar and report the earliest byte that makes the input impossible, including incomplete signed tokens.

diagnoses.bug: Wildcard partials accept later numeric fields, so inputs such as `1.x.2` silently become a range instead of returning Syntax.
diagnoses.lesson: Validate grammar statefully: once a wildcard or terminator appears, reject later fields that the grammar no longer permits.

diagnoses.bug: intersects checks only a finite set of stable boundary points and shared prerelease anchors, so it misses valid overlaps whose only witness is an unanchored prerelease admitted by include_prerelease=true or a discrete adjacent prerelease.
diagnoses.lesson: For ordered domains with discrete successors, derive witnesses from interval boundaries and adjacency rules instead of sampling a few representative points.

diagnoses.bug: intersects only tests a finite set of bound-derived candidate versions, so it misses valid witnesses between bounds and prerelease successors that are not in that sample.
diagnoses.lesson: For existence checks over ordered domains, reason about boundary adjacency and construct a complete witness method instead of sampling a few likely candidates.

diagnoses.bug: Justification uses indentation-adjusted width for extra spaces, but the requirement defines E as width minus the line's pre-justification scalar width, so indented lines are under-justified.
diagnoses.lesson: Translate sizing rules into explicit formulas and verify that each formula uses the specified coordinate system, especially when fixed padding is present.

diagnoses.bug: Raw splitting is offered even when the current suffix has a marker prefix that fits, and marker-ended lines omit completed-word consumption from their tie-break count.
diagnoses.lesson: Model every legal transition explicitly, then verify its eligibility conditions and all tie-break metrics against the full transition.

diagnoses.bug: decode_many calls Vec::with_capacity(count) before decoding, so an enormous count can panic or abort on capacity overflow instead of returning a Result.
diagnoses.lesson: Validate caller-controlled sizes before reserving memory; avoid infallible capacity requests when inputs can exceed representable or available allocation limits.

diagnoses.bug: decode_many uses Vec::with_capacity(count) before checking whether the input can contain that many values, so a huge count can panic or abort instead of returning an error.
diagnoses.lesson: Validate untrusted sizes before using them for allocation; prefer fallible, bounded allocation when input controls capacity.

lessons: Validate complete syntax left to right before processing values; report the earliest byte that makes the input invalid, and defer later errors until earlier components pass.
Preserve source positions and requested identities through parsing and traversal; report the exact failing component and mutate the resolved target while retaining aliases.
Model state transitions and mutations explicitly; verify eligibility, ordering, tie-breaks, and every success, error, and early-return path.
Preserve pending work across incremental boundaries; advance past a timestamp only after handling every event due there, and exclude work predating insertion.
Derive complete existence checks from ordered-domain boundaries and adjacency rules instead of sampling representative candidates.
Translate output and sizing requirements literally; verify generated formats and formulas against the specified coordinate system, including fixed padding.
Track maximal removable runs across adjacent whitespace and nested constructs, preserving original boundaries until validation.
Validate untrusted sizes before allocation; use fallible, bounded capacity requests when inputs control memory use.
